compatibility.detector_contract: additive read-only adapter; Detector.detect(context, units) remains unchanged
compatibility.detector_schema: ToolRunResult/ToolDiagnostic schema v1 read compatibility and first-party schema v2 source binding remain unchanged
compatibility.candidate_identity: existing candidate_id and diagnostic_id values are returned verbatim and are never rewritten
compatibility.evidence_obligations: returned as immutable records; a query never changes unknown/missing/satisfied/not_applicable
compatibility.coverage: complete/partial/not_analyzed/failed and parse_status remain independent; partial is never promoted to complete
compatibility.historical_reports: historical JSON, report hashes, reviews and source evidence are read-only
compatibility.external_tools: saved external outputs may be normalized as observations but cannot provide production semantic proof
compatibility.mutation: no public IR, runner, frontend, catalog, report or review mutation before owner approval

status_semantics.observed: A direct immutable record was recovered and source/evidence-bound; it is not a semantic proof.
status_semantics.proven: A semantic claim is supported by a complete, auditable proof for the declared analysis scope only.
status_semantics.unknown: The requested claim is not established because evidence, capability, identity, coverage or budget is insufficient.
status_semantics.failed: The query or provider failed, including invalid input or integrity mismatch; this proves neither absence nor safety.

conditional_fields.unknown_reason: required and non-null exactly when status=unknown
conditional_fields.failure_reason: required and non-null exactly when status=failed; null otherwise

facts_policy.unknown: null; missing evidence may be listed in unknown_reason but no guessed result is allowed

proof_ref_policy.proven: non-empty references whose verified=true and which include a proof certificate or complete analysis record
proof_ref_policy.unknown: may be empty, but the field must exist
proof_ref_policy.failed: may be empty, but the field must exist

rules: scope is explicit and smaller than or equal to the pinned ScanContext
paths are canonical source-relative POSIX paths
git_object source binding requires a full commit SHA
a semantic claim may only cover listed files/functions and declared build context
unlisted or partially analyzed regions remain outside the proof
every request and response carries requested and used budgets
valid analysis requests use positive integer requested limits
valid used values are non-negative integers no greater than requested limits
invalid zero, negative, missing or contradictory budgets return failed with failure_reason.code=invalid_budget and no facts
budget exhaustion returns unknown with unknown_reason.code=budget_exhausted
budget exhaustion never emits a truncated path or partial flow as a complete result

methods.name: get_symbol
methods.purpose: Resolve a source position to a stable symbol identity without inferring missing type or linkage semantics.
methods.observed_fact: syntax/token identity at the exact source hash
methods.proven_claim: fully resolved declaration/definition identity within the declared build context
methods.missing_behavior: unknown(identity_unresolved); never return a nearest-name guess

methods.name: get_cfg_path
methods.purpose: Return one auditable feasible control-flow path or a proven no-path result.
methods.observed_fact: recorded node/function identities and raw CFG edges when available
methods.proven_claim: a feasible source-to-sink path, or no path after complete CFG search in scope

methods.name: get_dataflow
methods.purpose: Return a bounded, auditable source-to-sink value-flow witness or a complete no-flow result.
methods.proven_claim: a concrete flow witness, or no flow after complete analysis within budget and scope

methods.name: get_guard_proof
methods.purpose: Prove guard dominance, negation and early-exit semantics for one sink node.
methods.observed_fact: syntax-level guard expression and node identity
methods.proven_claim: guard dominance and required branch outcome for the sink
methods.missing_behavior: unknown(required_fact_missing|analysis_partial); a nearby if statement is never proof

methods.name: get_lock_state
methods.purpose: Establish held/not-held lock state and synchronization identity at a location.
methods.observed_fact: recorded lexical lock syntax or annotations
methods.proven_claim: held/not-held state under resolved lock alias, RAII, try-lock and thread context

methods.name: get_build_context
methods.purpose: Bind a file to compilation database, TU, macros, includes, target and generated inputs.
methods.proven_claim: the exact build context used for a semantic claim
methods.missing_behavior: unknown(build_context_unavailable); never substitute host defaults or generic flags

methods.name: get_source_context
methods.purpose: Return exact source bytes/text for a bounded range with Git and source hashes.
methods.observed_fact: exact source range bound to blob and source_sha256
methods.proven_claim: not applicable in v0; source text is evidence, not semantic proof

methods.name: get_detector_results
methods.purpose: Read existing candidate diagnostics, limitations and EvidenceObligations without promotion.
methods.observed_fact: verbatim v2 record or explicitly unbound v1 record plus source binding state
methods.proven_claim: not applicable to vulnerability truth in v0; record identity may be verified but findings remain candidates

methods.name: get_coverage
methods.purpose: Read per-file detector/parse coverage and preserve partial and failed outcomes.
methods.proven_claim: complete coverage only when the recorded sidecar closes the exact declared scope
methods.missing_behavior: unknown(coverage_not_recorded|analysis_partial); never infer complete from task completion or zero findings

required_unknown_fallbacks: missing dataflow graph or alias model
